entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Living constructs of wood on Duskmourn that used to be humans, transformed by a warlock ritual.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Demonic overlord of Duskmourn whose Ascension spurred people to ward off fear.

entities.name: Hauntwoods
entities.description: Region of Duskmourn where wickerfolk are usually found.

entities.name: Shadowmoor scarecrows
entities.description: Scarecrows built by kithkin to farm and ward off visitors, some now independent.

events.summary: Warlocks discover a ritual that turns people into living wood, creating the wickerfolk.
events.quote: A group of warlocks discovered a ritual to transform them

relations.quote: These scarecrows are led by the Reaper King

relations.note: cobblesmiths and hedge mages built them
relations.quote: were created by kithkin cobblesmiths and hedge mages
